name: roots-miniapp-ci-tool
description: Isolated home for miniprogram-ci, kept deliberately OUT of the root package.json. It pulls an abandoned Babel 6 toolchain (dozens of critical advisories in npm audit) that has nothing to do with this app's own code — only scripts/upload_miniapp.js ever requires it, only a person publishing the mini app from their own machine ever installs it, and every other session/CI run on this shared repo should never see it or pay for installing it. See scripts/upload_miniapp.js for how it's resolved from here.
